note: eFV v4 wave 2 (EFV4 IL backfill), development read only: selects and adjudicates nothing

construction.as_of: facts announced strictly before the cutoff: V-01-01 on a list vintage (efv_drivers.protection_asof rule); the earlier of the matrix cutoff and 1 January of the decision year on a matrix row
construction.id: list vintage: the outcome-blind mlbam_id (efv_identity), never record_mlbam_id; matrix row: the matrix id, as base V2 reads it
construction.missing: no id: None on every column (imputed at the fold's has-block mean by the lab); il_absent is a DS-03 balance probe only

ground_truth_rerun.trigger: at least 100 pre-cutoff stints on the resolved debuted cohort (data/xfv_injury_history_eval.json revival_trigger)
ground_truth_rerun.oos_bar: the family is then re-tested out of sample exactly as every wave-2 column: forward-chained folds, DS-06 admission inside each fold on training vintages only, E_cond CI95 on the development frames (dev_read)

w_star_dev.convention: the k-th largest W3 on the rows, k = the number of six-season contributors; development convention on the fwar label, re-derived by EV-05 on the frozen label
